description: List the on-demand feed of recent AI and developer API changes (status flips, deprecation-page edits, model retirements, pricing-page edits). Use for a chosen window, one provider, or one kind, when explaining sudden breakage. Not for live up/down (check_api_status) and not for the once-a-day digest, which also covers MCP server breakage (get_digest). Returns summary, count, freshness, and changes[] with provider, kind, title, detail, source, and at, newest first. Status rows arrive within about 5 minutes; doc-page rows every few hours. A limit above 500 is clamped to 500; an unknown provider returns an empty list, not an error. Example: {"provider":"anthropic","kind":"model_retirement"}. Free within the daily quota, then $0.01 via x402. Alias: get_changes.

kind.description: Optional type filter. status = provider state flips; deprecations = deprecation-page line edits; model_retirement = a model id became deprecated or retired; pricing = pricing-page line edits. Omit for all four.

limit.description: How many changes to return, newest first. Positive integer. Omit for 100.

provider.description: Optional lowercase provider id from list_providers, e.g. openai or anthropic. Omit for every provider.

since.description: Exclusive lower bound compared to each change's at. ISO 8601 UTC. Example: 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Omit for 7 days ago.

name: list_recent_api_changes
title: What changed recently in AI/dev APIs?
